name: Bun rieu tom
summary: Bún riêu tôm is the coast’s bún riêu, with shrimp stock in place of crab: a naturally sweet broth with tangy tomato, shrimp cakes, tofu, squid, and pork. Greens go in the bowl and shrimp paste stays on the side.
origin: Vung Tau, the coastal answer to inland crab bún riêu.
taste: The shrimp stock is naturally sweet, sharpened with tomato and herbs.
howToEat: Put the greens in the bowl and add the shrimp paste only if you want it.
seoTitle: Bun rieu tom — shrimp noodle soup in Vung Tau
seoDescription: Bún riêu tôm is Vung Tau’s shrimp bún riêu: sweet shrimp stock, tomato, shrimp cakes, tofu, squid, and pork, with shrimp paste on the side.
